requirements: Case schema_version must be integer 1; source_reports_sha256 and rubric_sha256 must match the release.
Proposal, independent_assessment, decision and supporting_evidence use exact path/sha256 references relative to artifact root.

Decision requires accepted or independently_adjudicated_pending_release_integration status, original_artifacts_preserved true, distinct proposer_agent_id and adjudicator_agent_id matching actual document agent_id values.
Assessment session_id must be nonempty and different from proposer session_id; stage must equal independent_source_assessment.
Proposal and assessment both bind full source/rubric context. All decision top-level *_sha256 fields exactly match required and explicit supporting references.
Per target proposal requires exact source_path/source_sha256 and artifact_path/artifact_sha256; assessed record requires matching source_sha256.

Every accepted change requires source_sha256, original_review_path/original_review_sha256, before_state/before_evidence, after_state/after_evidence, independent_source_state/source_evidence, and nonempty reason.
Accepted after state/evidence must match proposal proposed_state/source_quote and assessment independent_source_state/source_evidence exactly.

Case changes must equal accepted keys and n_changes; each binds original reviewed batch and original full source batch. Before annotation must match preserved original review, not an unbound later view.
No-op annotations belong in semantic QA; runtime registry prohibits duplicate correction targets. Rejected or unresolved proposals must remain outside accepted_changes.
Each nonmissing annotation must carry an exact contiguous full-source substring; not_mentioned requires empty evidence.
